text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару makes it through the
Yayoi
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Once again, our next goal race is left to
fate! And
the gods decree that our next
race is... the
formidable Japanese Derby!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although she has some gripes with the
outcome,
Matikanefukukitaru accepts
her destiny. In order
to claim victory in
the Japanese Derby, she... runs
off to
improve her luck at a shrine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
